card.name: Linking words after lymphoma mentions
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "including", "involving" or a comma right after lymphoma or lymphoproliferative disorder in warning text. The next words usually name lymphoma subtypes or the CNS.

modes.label: Including after lymphomas
modes.description: The word "including" after "lymphomas," introducing subtypes such as Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's.
modes.example: Approximately half the cases were lymphomas,<< including>> Hodgkin's and non-Hodg

modes.label: Involving the CNS
modes.description: The word "involving" after "predominantly" in post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder warnings.
modes.example: Increased risk for developing post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD), predominantly<< involving>> the central nervous system (CNS).

card.plain: It marks the small linking word that comes just before a list of lymphoma types or the site of the lymphoma in a warning.
